definitions.explanation: A train designed for transporting cargo rather than passengers. Composed of 貨物 (freight, cargo) and 列車 (train).

examples.japanese: {貨物列車|かもつれっしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通過|つうか}した→通過する：22435_tsuukasuru⟧。
⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{貨物列車|かもつれっしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{踏切|ふみきり}→踏切：06493_fumikiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塞|ふさ}いでいた→塞ぐ：00046_fusagu⟧。
examples.english: A long freight train was blocking the railroad crossing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{貨物列車|かもつれっしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: Late at night, freight trains carry goods from factories to the port.

notes:
USAGE:
{貨物列車|かもつれっしゃ} is a straightforward compound noun. In everyday speech, it is sometimes shortened to ⟦{貨物|かもつ}→貨物：00165_kamotsu⟧ when the context makes it clear that a train is being discussed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貨物列車|かもつれっしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (a freight train runs)
- {貨物列車|かもつれっしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通過|つうか}→通過：03506_tsuuka⟧ (passage of a freight train)
- {貨物列車|かもつれっしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧ (freight train schedule)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{旅客列車|りょかくれっしゃ}→旅客列車：23582_ryokakuressha⟧ is the counterpart, meaning passenger train. {貨車|かしゃ} refers to an individual freight car/wagon rather than the whole train.
